title: 離散数学
subtitle: Discrete Mathematics
keywords: Set and logic 2.Relation and mapping 3.Algebraic system
educationalGoal: Following the recent progress in AI technology demands a knowledge of mathematics. Discrete mathematics is an essential part of mathematics necessary for developing information technology. The subjects dealt with in this course are required in succeeding courses.
advice: In this course, we learn the following topics: 1. Sets and their operations 2. Propositional logic 3. Predicate and quantifier 4. Mathematical induction 5. Relation 6. Equivalence class 7. Mapping 8. Semigroup 9. Group 10. Modulo arithmetics and residue class 11. Ring 12. Field Since all topics are abstract, students are strongly recommended to solve the exercises by themselves.
books: やさしく学べる離散数学,石村園子,共立出版
requiredKnowledge: There are no prerequisites. If students encounter something they cannot understand, they will be expected to resolve it by utilizing office hours.

activityGoals.body: Be able to obtain the truth value of a formula in propositional logic.
Be able to classify elements according to the equivalence class.
Be able to perform modulo arithmetic.
Be able to explain isomorphism of groups.
Be able to perform arithmetic operations of polynomials over a field.
